_doc: The active flag selects autonomous strategy tooling. Receiver-managed production bots use production_live=true even when active=false. monitor=true enables exporter coverage without enabling autonomous tooling; live risk classification always comes from the runtime dry_run flag. capital_account names the exchange account a bot trades from; bots sharing one account are valued once from actual account equity in the circuit breaker (FundingFadeV1 and KeltnerBounceV1 both run on the same Binance spot wallet). capital_owner declares the representative API reader for a shared wallet; balances never elect the reader. The dashboard/compose registry is the runtime source of truth.

ShortKeltnerV2HL._note: Monitor the deployed bot in either mode; its effective dry_run flag determines inclusion in the live circuit breaker. Autonomous strategy tooling remains disabled.

CascadeFaderV1._note: retired 2026-07-13 — fill-stress study: PF 0.98 @0.5% slippage, backtest case unreliable (cascade-fill-stress-2026-07)

KillersScalpV1._note: Receiver-managed bounded live executor on a dedicated Hyperliquid account; posted-SL risk sizing, native exchange stop, and receiver fallback enabled.

InsidersScalpV1._note: Receiver-managed bounded live executor on a dedicated Hyperliquid account; V2 config uses the shared hardened Killers execution strategy.
